Employment of Foreigners in the Republic of Serbia

Foreign citizens may be employed on condition that they possess a long-stay visa granted on the grounds of employment, a temporary or permanent residence permit and the single permit, unless otherwise stipulated by this Law.

An employer may conclude an employment contract with a foreign citizen in compliance with the law regulating labour.

Other than for reasons stipulated by the law regulating labour, a foreigner’s employment relationship shall also be terminated upon the expiration of the validity of the single permit.

An employer may not hire employers or use their services if they are illegally staying in the Republic of Serbia and if they do not meet the requirements for employment / temporary employment.

Within 30 days of the termination of the employment contract, or another contract under which a foreigner is entitled to labour-related rights stipulated by law without entering into an employment relationship, the foreigner shall conclude a new employment contract or another contract under which a foreigner is entitled to labour-related rights stipulated by law without entering into an employment relationship; otherwise, the provisions of the law regulating the requirements for the entry, movement, stay, and repatriation of foreigners shall apply.

The employer shall keep the evidence that the hired foreigner has fulfilled the requirements for employment / temporary employment.

Law Amending the Law on Employment of Foreign Citizens (Official Gazette of the Republic of Serbia, No 62/2023)

Change of employer, work for two or more employers, change of the grounds on which the single permit is issued during its validity period

Foreigners working in the Republic of Serbia in jobs for which they have been issued a Single Permit (residence and work permit) may change their employer, or work for two or more employers, or change the grounds of which the Single Permit is issued during the validity of the Single Permit, subject to APPROVAL from the National Employment Service (NES).

The request for changing the grounds on which the Single Permit is issued, changing the employer or taking up work with two or more employers may be submitted by the foreigner, or the employer on behalf of the foreigner, or by a legal or natural person authorized by the foreigner or the employer.

The request will be decided upon by the locally competent organizational unit of the National Employment Service, within 10 days of receiving an appropriately submitted request. The request for approval shall be submitted to the NES branch office competent for the territory in which the employer has it seat.

A foreigner may change the grounds on which the Single Permit is issued, change the employer or take up work with two or more employers, upon obtaining the NES approval. Until the establishment of the service on the Single Portal intended for submitting the request for approval, it can be submitted to the National Employment Service by email, at the NES registry office, or by mail.

Once the tehnical conditions are met, the request for approval will be submitted electronically via the Single Portal, within the service for issuing single permits to foreigners, in accordance with the instructions for using the service for issuing single permits to foreigners.

The requirements or proof to be attached to the request for approval are identical to the requirements and proof needed for a specific type of assessment that the NES performs as part of the procedure of issuing the single permit (for example, in the case of employment with a new or different employer, the assessment requirements for employment must be fulfilled, or in the case of registering a sole proprietorship, the assessment requirements for self-employment must be fulfilled).
